article.title: How Indian Reforms Power US-India Defense Cooperation
article.summary: U.S.-India defense cooperation has accelerated in the past decade. Today, India conducts more military exercises with the United States than with any other country. American platforms also underpin some of India’s most important military capabilities. The Indian Navy flies P-8I maritime patrol aircraft, operates MH-60R helicopters, MQ-9B drones,  and uses sonobuoys.
